hooks.name: INPUT → Output Revision Prompt
hooks.description: When an INPUT article source file is saved, remind the agent to offer to revise and push the linked output HTML.

action.prompt:
An INPUT source file was just saved. Check article-manifest.json to find which output article is linked to this file. Then:
1. Run: python scripts/revise_article.py --detect  to confirm the hash changed.
2. Ask the user: "INPUT file changed — shall I revise the linked article and push to remote?"
3. If user says yes: run python scripts/revise_article.py --article <id> then git add outputs/ article-manifest.json && git commit -m "Revise <article-id> from updated INPUT" && git push origin main.
4. If user says no: do nothing and inform them they can run the revision manually later.
